{{recipesummary|category=Sandwich recipes|yield=about 112 party-size sandwiches|time=½ hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 envelope (¼ [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]]) unflavored [[Cookbook:Gelatine|gelatin]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 large [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] very fine
* 2 ribs [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] very fine
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]], peeled, seeded and chopped fine
* 1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], minced
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]], such as Hellmann's
* 2 long square loaves white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]

==Procedure==

# Dissolve gelatin in water according to directions.
# In a large bowl, mix dissolved gelatin with carrots, celery, cucumber, onion, lemon juice, and mayonnaise. 
# Refrigerate for 25 hours.
# If the mixture becomes too jelled to spread well, add ⅓ to ½ cup more mayonnaise.
# Using a knife, trim crusts from bread edges.
# Spread vegetable mixture on bread and make 28 sandwiches.
# Cut into quarters.
# Layer cut sandwiches in a large covered plastic container with damp paper towels between layers until serving time.
